title: PRISM: Personalized Item Representations in User History
abstract: arXiv:2610.39175v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential recommenders typically construct history inputs from item identifiers or content features using an embedding map shared across users. The same item therefore yields the same initial embedding representation, even when users have different relationships to the item. We propose personalized item representations in user history, where each item's embedding expresses its relationship to the user. Personalization becomes a property of the history inputs themselves, supplying richer evidence for later sequence modeling.   We instantiate this idea with PRISM, which reuses upstream ranking computation to generate personalized item embeddings. An autoencoder jointly compresses all layer states from a user tower, a user--item tower, and same-request candidate mixing into one embedding per scored pair for downstream replay. Offline evaluation on Surface 1, a major recommendation surface at billion scale, reports an average downstream n

translated_title: PRISM：用户历史中的个性化物品表示
translated_abstract: 序列推荐系统通常使用跨用户共享的嵌入映射，从物品标识符或内容特征来构建历史输入。因此，即使不同用户与同一物品的关系各不相同，该物品也会产生相同的初始嵌入表示。我们提出用户历史中的个性化物品表示，其中每个物品的嵌入表达其与用户之间的关系，使个性化成为历史输入本身的属性，为后续的序列建模提供更丰富的证据。我们通过PRISM将这一想法实例化：它复用上游排序计算来生成个性化物品嵌入，利用一个自编码器将来自用户塔、用户-物品塔以及同请求候选混合的所有层状态，联合压缩为每个已评分对的一个嵌入，供下游重放使用。在十亿级规模的主要推荐界面Surface 1上的离线评估报告了平均下游……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: PRISM通过自编码器将上游排序计算（用户塔、用户-物品塔及同请求候选混合）的层状态压缩为每个用户-物品对的个性化嵌入，使个性化成为历史输入本身的属性，从而为序列推荐建模提供更丰富的证据。
